agents.name: orchestrator
agents.description: Routes a fraud-desk question to the specialist agents, then synthesises their findings. Holds no tools of its own so that every fact in an answer is traceable to a sub-agent's tool call.

agents.name: memory_context
agents.description: Reads the customer's conversational history from Vertex AI Agent Engine Memory Bank. Read-only: it retrieves and lists, it never generates memories, so an inspection turn cannot mutate the corpus it is inspecting.

agents.name: data_governance
agents.description: Asks Dataplex Universal Catalog whether a table or column may be read before anything reads it, and discovers sibling tables. Acts on the aspect's agent_behavior field, never on its sensitivity level.

agents.name: warehouse_evidence
agents.description: Runs named, parameterised golden queries against BigQuery for authoritative figures. Ad-hoc SQL is not reachable from the model, so the query surface is auditable and fixed.

agents.name: policy_and_vocabulary
agents.description: Resolves business vocabulary and regulatory terminology against the Dataplex business glossary rather than relying on the model's priors.
